patch_description:
Restore a symmetry-aware, motif-aligned ansatz that previously yielded stronger
validation/test performance. The block groups single-qubit rotations by the
natural tic-tac-toe symmetry zones (corners / edges / center), uses separate
CRZ parameters for the outer ring and radial center couplings, and explicitly
allocates ZZZ three-qubit motifs along the eight winning lines. CCRZ gates
are included for higher-order center/diagonal correlations and are split into
center/diag parameter groups. Final rotations keep separate corner/edge/center
keys. This specification preserves parameter efficiency (same per-block
parameter count) while restoring geometric inductive biases that help the
model learn the win-line motifs and improved generalization.
